description: Cross-section: the conclusion asserts a mechanism the experiments never isolated.

inputs.label: Full draft
inputs.content:
Problem: Federated learning degrades under label skew.
Gap: Prior distillation methods use a single global teacher.
Question: Does teacher specialization improve federated distillation?
H1: Class-specialized teachers improve knowledge transfer under label skew.

Methodology: We train 8 teachers, each on 2 classes, and distill into a global student.
Baselines: FedAvg.

E4: specialized ensemble (8 teachers) vs single non-specialized teacher.
R1: 74.8% vs 71.2%, one run each, no variance reported.

F1: Specialization improves knowledge transfer.
C1: Class-specialized teachers are a superior mechanism for federated knowledge
transfer, and our results demonstrate that specialization is the cause of the gain.

Limitations: More datasets could be tested in future work.
